executable.title: Pathomic Feature Extraction
executable.description: Feature extraction allows users to extract 72 morphometric and intensity-based features for each FTU (ignores Spots and Interstitium annotations)
executable.acknowledgements: This work is part of efforts in digital pathology by the Sarder Lab: UFL.

image.name: input_image
image.label: Input Image
image.description: The whole slide image(s) (WSI) for which feature extraction will be done

integer.name: threshold_nuclei
integer.label: Threshold for Nuclei
integer.description: Defines the pixel intensity threshold used to identify the nuclear sub compartment. Pixels with intensities above this value are classified as nuclei.

integer.name: minsize_nuclei
integer.label: Minimum Size for Nuclei
integer.description: Specifies the minimum allowable size (in pixels) for the detected nuclear objects. Objects smaller than this threshold are discarded as noise or artifacts.

integer.name: threshold_PAS
integer.label: Threshold for PAS
integer.description: Defines the pixel intensity threshold for the PAS-stained sub compartment (if a pixel does not already belong to the nuclei subcompartment).

integer.name: minsize_PAS
integer.label: Minimum Size for PAS
integer.description: Specifies the minimum size (in pixels) for PAS-positive objects. Small PAS regions below this size are removed.

integer.name: threshold_LS
integer.label: Threshold for Luminal Space
integer.description: Defines the pixel intensity threshold for detecting the luminal space sub compartment (if a pixel does not already belong to either the nuclei or PAS subcompartment)

integer.name: minsize_LS
integer.label: Minimum Size Luminal Space
integer.description: Specifies the minimum size (in pixels) for detected luminal space regions. Filters out very small or spurious luminal detections.

parameters.label: Girder API URL and Key

string.name: girderToken
string.label: Girder API Token
